system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook that installs nginx on a target Ubuntu host, ensures the service is started and enabled at boot, and opens port 80 in the firewall.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook that installs nginx on a target Ubuntu host, ensures the service is started and enabled at boot, and opens port 80 in the firewall.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure nginx on Ubuntu
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    nginx_package: nginx
    nginx_service: nginx
    nginx_http_port: 80

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure target is an Ubuntu host
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'
        fail_msg: "This playbook only supports Ubuntu hosts (detected: {{ ansible_facts['distribution'] | default('unknown') }})."

    - name: Update apt package cache
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600

  tasks:
    - name: Install nginx
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: "{{ nginx_package }}"
        state: present
        install_recommends: false

    - name: Ensure nginx service is started and enabled at boot
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ nginx_service }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Ensure UFW is installed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: ufw
        state: present

    - name: Allow OpenSSH through UFW (prevent lockout)
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        name: OpenSSH
      when: ansible_facts['service_mgr'] is defined

    - name: Allow HTTP (port {{ nginx_http_port }}/tcp) through UFW
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: "{{ nginx_http_port }}"
        proto: tcp

    - name: Set UFW default incoming policy to deny
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: incoming
        policy: deny

    - name: Set UFW default outgoing policy to allow
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: outgoing
        policy: allow

    - name: Enable and persist UFW
      community.general.ufw:
        state: enabled
        logging: 'on'

  handlers:
    - name: Restart nginx
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ nginx_service }}"
        state: restarted
